title: brainstorm/planner now dispatch on pi runtime (was claude-code)
rationale: Operator request 2026-05-22 to move the interactive Plot scouts off claude-code onto pi. Safe because the read-only (brainstorm) and .plot/.seeds-only (planner) contract is enforced in the system prompt, not by the underlying runtime — burrow_config only forwards [sandbox].network. Tradeoff: pi is a multi-provider runtime so the model identity behind these agents now depends on pi's provider config rather than implicitly Anthropic. Follow-up warren-b802 will lift this to a .warren/config.yaml knob so operators don't need to fork warren to flip it again.

description: auto_plan_run string/boolean trap: canopy's cn create/update --fm key=value stringifies all values, but warren's reap gate is strict (frontmatter.auto_plan_run === true, src/runs/reap/auto-plan-run.ts:14). Any canopy-authored agent setting auto_plan_run via --fm silently loses plan auto-dispatch. Warren's own project-tier nightwatch override carried the string form until hand-fixed in .canopy/prompts.jsonl (2026-06-11).
resolution: Hand-edit the canopy store value to a JSON boolean and verify with cn render <name> --json; durable fix is warren-side coercion of 'true'/'false' strings (warren-5f07).

title: Audit population: three constitution-enforcing cron auditors with asymmetric autonomy
rationale: Forensic audit of merged history (PR #270 title/diff mismatch, 1.3pt silent coverage decay, grandfather-at-birth, gates-green prod break) showed drift lives around the gates, not in them — so auditors map to failure classes, not gates. Mechanical auditors get auto_plan_run dispatch authority immediately; the judgment auditor (tastewatch) must earn it via tracked precision, mirroring the operator's own gate-to-auditor transition.

description: A raw NUL byte (0x00) embedded in a TypeScript template literal (used as a map-key separator in src/triggers/cron-retry.ts) makes git classify the source file as binary (diffs show 'Bin', file(1) says 'data') while Biome/tsc/bun accept it silently.
resolution: Use the \u0000 escape sequence instead of a literal control byte — runtime-identical, keeps the file text.

name: bot-commit-git-env-composition
description: Warren bot git commits need BOTH env families composed at every spawn site: gitRepoContextScrubEnv() (maps GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_INDEX_FILE/GIT_COMMON_DIR/GIT_PREFIX/GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY/etc to undefined so the child drops them) spread first, then warrenCommitIdentityEnv() (explicit GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_* from WARREN_BOT_IDENTITY) spread second. Plain '-c user.name' config args lose to inherited GIT_AUTHOR_* env, and inherited GIT_DIR diverts commits into the parent repo when run from a git hook (git commit exports GIT_INDEX_FILE/GIT_PREFIX/GIT_DIR to hooks). The spawn adaptors (util.ts execFile + three defaultSpawn copies) share resolveSpawnEnv() in src/projects/clone.ts, where env values of undefined mean 'remove from child env' — a plain spread merge cannot unset. Fixed in warren-035c + warren-fa84; remaining sites tracked in warren-23dd.

acceptance:container fails on a clean checkout/worktree with 'env file .env not found': base docker-compose.yml declares env_file: [.env] and the compose override's env_file: [] does NOT suppress it — Docker Compose concatenates env_file lists rather than replacing. Tracked as warren-9cda.
resolution: touch .env (gitignored) to unblock; proper fix is base entry env_file: [{path: .env, required: false}]

name: stdin-hold-contract-for-reimplemented-dispatchers
description: Burrow stdin-hold contract: runtimes declaring shouldCloseStdinOnEvent (pi/leveret/healer) exit the instant stdin closes, even mid-inference — any dispatcher reimplementing spawn (e.g. K8s agent-entrypoint) must hold stdin open until the runtime's terminal event (agent_end) and only flush, not end, after writing the prompt. Missing this yields the burrow-5db3 signature: exit 0 ~2s in with only prompt-ack events, run falsely 'succeeded'. Fixed for K8s in src/runtime/k8s/agent-stdin-hold.ts (warren-7a43).

title: Deletion pass planned as pl-3a79 (conversations → plot → canopy)
rationale: PHILOSOPHY rule 8: features with no users are deleted, not re-platformed; ordering is dependency-driven (conversations call plotCreator/plotSyncer; warden constitution leans on both).

title: Bundled-features narrative aligned to mulch/seeds/sapling after pl-3a79
rationale: Final alignment pass (warren-0515) rewrote the bundled-features story across CLAUDE.md, README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PHILOSOPHY.md, and ROADMAP.md. Warren no longer bundles five os-eco tools: the narrative is now mulch/seeds/sapling as opt-in integrations plus the inline built-in agent registry (claude-code, sapling, pi, planner, nightwatch, bugwatch, pr-fixer, healer). plan-run is a dispatch mode over the single-run primitive. Two verification notes for future doc work: (1) the live agent.pauseTimeoutMs config knob's SPEC home sits inside the RETIRED SPEC §11.O, so cite §11.H + src/warren-config/schema.ts instead; (2) POST /agents/refresh is gone from ROUTE_TABLE, so it must not appear in the README HTTP API table.

description: Ontology/validation-gap audit (2026-08-02): warren's recurring defect class is the comment-as-invariant pattern — invariants written in comments/prose with no mechanism to fail when they stop holding. Examples: run.ts base-branch comment went stale after warren-dac8 (caused warren-8cbf/e14e); pr-open.ts baseBranch param used only in telemetry while the action uses defaultBranch; blocks DAG zod-parsed then discarded (warren-df0b); FINALIZE_STAGES hand-copy missing seed_reset (warren-7b7a); warren-extensions.ts documented trigger-drift risk whose reconciliation never landed (warren-c486).
resolution: Counter-pattern already in-repo: wire.ts + check:wire-types and the two ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS tables — vocabulary with a machine that fails on drift. New enum-shaped constraints belong in src/core/wire.ts with runtime membership checks at the HTTP boundary, not in comments. Twelve issues filed to close the enforcement gaps: warren-3a75/6646/b27c/7b7a/66d2/02aa/c4be/50c8/55cf/50a7/c486/b3be.
